whyThisCauseAndNotImageBoundary: The vocabulary admits exactly ONE cause per line, so the two real facts compete and the tie must be broken on something other than preference.

The geometry failure is MEASURED — a binary verdict the instrument produces. The claim that the photos dominate the 3.30% is an INFERENCE: settling it needs a region-masked score isolating the four card image areas, and the case declares a single `whole` region (2 408 529 signal px, no breakdown).

Building that masking capability is measurement work 014 is not allowed to do (FR-005: a triage does not repair, and the feature builds no new capability). So the dominance question is open, and a cause resting on it would be exactly the asserted-without-measurement cause this feature exists to refuse.

Between two candidate causes, the one backed by a measurement the instrument already produces wins — and it is also the one already registered as work (DW-002), so the line lands in 015 where someone will look at the -4px.

openQuestionForwarded.question: Of the 3.30% residual, what share is the four missing card photos and what share is the -4px row overflow? Answering it needs a region-masked score on the carte image areas — a measurement capability, to be built where measurement may be built.
openQuestionForwarded.consequence: If 015 measures the photos as dominant, this line re-classes to image-boundary and its receipt records the infirmation. The attribution is provisional in its ORDERING, never in its evidence.
